skill.name: ui-component-creation
skill.description: Creates shadcn/ui components that follow project design tokens, responsive patterns, interaction states, and accessibility requirements.
skill.summary: Builds consistent shadcn/ui components from a project design system.

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent UI components that follow local design rules. This skill guides shadcn/ui creation with tokens, states, responsive layouts, and accessibility.
actual_capabilities: Directs agents to read the project design system before creating UI.
Provides a shadcn/ui component pattern using Card and Button components.
Specifies required design tokens for colors, spacing, and borders.
Identifies forbidden raw Tailwind color and grid patterns.
Requires hover, focus, disabled, responsive, and accessibility states.
limitations: Assumes the project already uses shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and matching design tokens.
Does not include installation steps for shadcn/ui or component dependencies.
Does not validate generated code with automated accessibility or visual tests.
Uses a generic data prop example and does not define domain-specific data models.

use_cases.title: Build a New Product Card
use_cases.description: Create a reusable card that follows project tokens, states, and responsive behavior.

use_cases.title: Standardize Feature Panels
use_cases.description: Turn varied interface requests into components that use the same visual system.

use_cases.title: Review UI Generation Requests
use_cases.description: Guide AI-assisted component work toward accessible, brand-aligned output.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small reusable UI element.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a shadcn/ui card component for [purpose]. Use our design tokens, responsive spacing, and accessible labels.

prompt_templates.title: Add Interaction States
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a component with user actions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [component type] with hover, focus, disabled, and loading states. Use design tokens instead of raw Tailwind colors.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Existing Markup
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an existing component so it matches the design system.
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this component to use shadcn/ui patterns, project color tokens, responsive breakpoints, and accessible controls: [paste component].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Component Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for multiple related interface components.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a coordinated set of [components] for [workflow]. Include variants, empty states, error states, responsive behavior, and accessibility details.

output_examples.input: Create a dashboard summary card for monthly sales data.
output_examples.output: A reusable card component plan with token-based surface colors, clear title hierarchy, action button styling, and responsive spacing.

output_examples.input: Refactor a feature panel that uses raw gray and white classes.
output_examples.output: A design-system aligned panel that replaces raw color classes with approved text, background, accent, and border tokens.

output_examples.input: Create a responsive three-column statistics section.
output_examples.output: A responsive layout that avoids fixed mobile columns and defines accessible labels, states, and breakpoint behavior.

best_practices: Provide the relevant design-system file or token names before requesting component work.
Ask for all required states, including hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty, and error states.
Review generated components for accessibility, responsive behavior, and token consistency.
anti_patterns: Do not request raw Tailwind color classes when the project has design tokens.
Do not accept fixed desktop grid layouts without mobile and tablet behavior.
Do not omit interactive states for buttons, cards, forms, or navigation elements.

faq.question: What frameworks does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets shadcn/ui components in a Tailwind CSS project with a defined design system.

faq.question: Does it install shadcn/ui?
faq.answer: No. It assumes the project already has the needed UI components and tokens available.

faq.question: Can it create responsive layouts?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill requires responsive breakpoints and warns against fixed multi-column layouts.

faq.question: Does it support accessibility requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. It calls for accessibility details, including aria labels and complete interaction states.

faq.question: Can it refactor existing components?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide refactors toward shadcn/ui patterns and approved design tokens.

faq.question: Is this a security-sensitive skill?
faq.answer: It is mainly a design and frontend coding guide. The audited file contains documentation only.
